problem: The onlyppt branch was still coupled to the paper/research pipeline
root_cause: The workflow boundary was unclear; autosearch still contained research code and samples
fix: Created a standalone D:\autoppt project root containing only autopptskills, PPT presentation/stage9 code, the PPT skill, tests, and documentation
reusable_rule: The PPT project root must not contain paper writing, experiments, submissions, or research samples

problem: Quality lessons were scattered across run directories, so later generations repeated known defects
root_cause: There was no stable cross-project improvement ledger or style-handbook entry point
fix: Added improvement/ppt-improvement-ledger.jsonl and improvement/style-handbook.md, and made the quality iterator read them
reusable_rule: Read the ledger before every generation/iteration and record failures, root causes, repairs, and verification evidence afterward

problem: Sparse-label repair and truncated supporting text conflicted with the user's requested dense academic slides; profile accents and visual review lacked the approved defaults.
root_cause: Prompt routes and installed skill carried older, inconsistent density and style rules.
fix: Integrated the approved style prompt into three prompt routes; retained all reviewed support; adopted red emphasis; synchronized the installed skill and retained official reference profiles; required information_density, restrained_style and master_visual_fidelity in Gold design review.
evidence: Explicit user direction on 2026-09-20; references/approved-style-contract.md; 27 targeted tests and 4 subtests passed; both skill validation and portability checks passed. No generated deck or pixel-equivalence result is claimed.
reusable_rule: Use information-rich pale academic pages with dark text and red emphasis; preserve scientific expression and native ordinary text/simple geometry; block final release on visible mismatch with the frozen ImageGen master.

problem: The first editable reconstruction could appear editable while relying on a full-slide image and proxy text; direct tracing also risked damaging scientific artwork and CJK title wrapping.
root_cause: The route lacked a portable measured-plan composer, explicit native-trace/raster routing, and a hard audit for invisible or out-of-bounds text.
fix: Added a measured reconstruction route with frozen-master hashes, separate source_bbox/layout_bbox, native text/simple geometry, bounded raster exceptions with reasons, isolated flat-icon OOXML freeforms, native solid-color backgrounds, hash-bound layer review, and fail-closed visible-text audits.
evidence: runs/zhengzhangxuan_defense_20260920/round2 and out_final release evidence: 11 slides; 176 native text boxes; 341/341 exact tokens; 25 native traces; 28 bounded images; zero semantic full-slide pictures; zero invalid text objects; PowerPoint, overflow, layer, visual-review and aggregate release gates pass.
reusable_rule: For a reviewed ImageGen master, use measured semantic reconstruction; never use full-slide semantic raster or hidden proxy text, and choose raster over vector whenever Office rendering or scientific meaning would degrade.
